TID_ACHIEVEMENT_DESTROY_ARTILLERY_COMPLE: Total Eagle or Inferno Artilleries destroyed: <value>

TID_ACHIEVEMENT_DESTROY_INFERNO: Destroy <number> Inferno Towers in Multiplayer battles
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_DESTROY_MULTI_ARCHER: Destroy <number> Multi-Archer Towers in Multiplayer Battles
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_DESTROY_MULTI_GEAR_TOWER: Destroy <number> Multi-Gear Towers in Multiplayer Battles
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_DESTROY_RICOCHET_CANNON: Destroy <number> Ricochet Cannons in Multiplayer Battles
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_DESTROY_SEASONAL_DEFENSE: Destroy <number> Crafted Defenses in Multiplayer Battles
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_DESTROY_SPELL_TOWER: Destroy <number> Spell Towers in Multiplayer Battles
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_DESTROY_TOWNHALL: Destroy <number> Town Halls in Multiplayer battles
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_DESTROY_TOWNHALL2: Destroy <number> Builder Halls in Builder Battles
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_DESTROY_WEAPONISED_BUILD: Destroy <number> weaponized Builder's Huts in Multiplayer battles
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_DESTROY_WEAPONISED_TH: Destroy <number> weaponized Town Halls in Multiplayer battles
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_DESTROY_XBOW_ONE: Destroy one X-Bow in a Multiplayer battle
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_DONATE_CAPITAL: Contribute <number> Capital Gold to upgrades in the Clan Capital
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_DONATE_UNITS: Donate <number> capacity worth of reinforcements to Clanmates

TID_ACHIEVEMENT_NPC_STARS: Win <number> Stars on the Campaign Map
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_PEKKA_SLAYER: Defeat M.O.M.M.A on the Campaign Map
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_SPELL_DONATION: Donate <number> Spell storage capacity worth of Spells
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_VICTORY_POINTS: Achieve a total of <number> trophies in Multiplayer battles
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_VS_BATTLE_TROPHIES: Achieve a total of <number> trophies in Builder Battles
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_WAR_LOOT: Collect <number> Gold from the Clan Castle
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_WAR_LOOT_COMPLETED: Total Gold collected in Clan War bonuses: <value>
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_WAR_STARS: Score <number> Stars for your clan in Clan War battles
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_WAR_STARS_COMPLETED: Total Stars scored for clan in Clan War battles: <value>
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_WL_STARS: Score <number> Stars for your clan in War League battles
TID_ACHIEVEMENT_WL_STARS_COMPLETED: Total Stars scored for clan in War League battles: <value>
TID_ADVANCED_MEGA_TRAP_INFO: A hidden dose of heavy destruction. Choose air or ground!
TID_ADVANCED_TRAP_INFO: Plan an explosive surprise for troops that get too close. Choose air or ground!
TID_AIR_BLASTER_INFO: Air Sweepers control the sky with strong blasts of air that push back flying enemies. Air Sweepers can only face one direction, so rotate them to maximize their effectiveness.
TID_AIR_DEFENSE2_INFO: For heavyweight air defense, Air Bombs do the trick. An endless supply of explosive barrels launch into the sky to ravage flying enemies!
TID_AIR_DEFENSE_INFO: This anti-air tower is deadly against flying enemies, but can't target foes on the ground. Place it wisely to cover as much airspace as possible.
TID_AIR_DEFENSE_SMALL_INFO: Keep flying pests away with flurries of small rockets! It's like a bug zapper, but prettier.
TID_ALCHEMIST_APPRENTICE_INFO: Alchemist converts resources into different types once a day. Level her up to increase her effectiveness!
TID_ALLIANCE_CASTLE_INFO: The Clan Castle houses your Treasury and any reinforcement troops or Spells sent by your clanmates.
TID_ANGRY_SPELL_ANGER_INFO: Why I oughta!\n\n Distilled from the jelly of the Pet House’s grumpiest resident, the Angry Spell infuriates troops within its ironically sweet-smelling radius, making them target defenses temporarily.
TID_ARCHER_TOWER2_INFO: No foe can escape the Archer's arrows. This tower has a special switch - choose long range or fast attack!
TID_ARCHER_TOWER_INFO: Archer Towers have longer range than Cannons, and unlike Cannons, they can attack flying enemies.
TID_ARTILLERY_INFO: The Eagle Artillery has nearly unlimited range and targets tough enemies with exploding shells. However, it won't activate until a large amount of troops have been deployed.
TID_BABY_DRAGON_INFO: This fire-breathing hatchling is shy around other air units, but leave it alone and it'll throw a fit! When not around other air units, Baby Dragons become enraged and gain bonus damage and attack speed.
TID_BARRACK2_INFO: The Builder Barracks trains troops for Builder Battles! You can also quickly swap troops immediately before attacking. Upgrade the Builder Barracks to unlock more troop types!
TID_BARRACK_INFO: The Barracks allow you to train troops to attack your enemies. Upgrade the Barracks to unlock advanced units that can win epic battles.
TID_BASIC_TURRET_INFO: Cannons are great for point defense. Upgrade Cannons to increase their firepower, but beware that your defenses cannot shoot while being upgraded!
TID_BIRTHDAY_SPELL_INFO: Summon an explosive surprise to celebrate the anniversary! This classy gift damages and stuns nearby buildings and troops.
TID_BOB_HUT_INFO: B.O.B, a totally normal Builder, lives here among us. Definitely not a robot controlled from the Builder Base.
TID_BOB_UNLOCK_BUILDING_INFO: Control center for Master Builder's latest invention! Once fully upgraded, B.O.B becomes an additional builder in the Home Village!
TID_BOOSTER_BOOST_PRODUCTION_INFO: This energetic Elixir boosts your Army production, increasing efficiency of Barracks, Spell Factories, Workshop and Hero regeneration for <time>. Works in Home Village.
TID_BOOSTER_BOOST_RESOURCES_INFO: Boost resource collector efficiency for <time> in Home Village.
TID_BOOSTER_BUILDERS_INFO: Boost Builder work to 10x its regular speed for <time> in Home Village. The Builder's Apprentice will not be affected.
TID_BOOSTER_CLOCKTOWER_INFO: Activate Clock Tower boost for <time>. Works in Builder Base!
TID_BOOSTER_FILL_DARK_ELIXIR_STORAGE_INF: Completely fill your Dark Elixir storages in Home Village.
TID_BOOSTER_FILL_ELIXIR2_STORAGE_INFO: Completely fill your Builder Elixir Storages in Builder Base.
TID_BOOSTER_FILL_ELIXIR_STORAGE_INFO: Completely fill your Elixir Storages in Home Village.
TID_BOOSTER_FILL_GOLD2_STORAGE_INFO: Completely fill your Builder Gold Storages in Builder Base.
TID_BOOSTER_FILL_GOLD_STORAGE_INFO: Completely fill your Gold Storages in Home Village.
TID_BOOSTER_FINISH_ANY_UPGRADE_INFO: Instantly finish any upgrade. Works in both villages!
TID_BOOSTER_FINISH_BUILDING_UPGRADE_INFO: Instantly finish any building upgrade. Works in both villages!
TID_BOOSTER_FINISH_HERO_UPGRADE_INFO: Instantly finish a Hero or Pet upgrade. Works in both villages!
TID_BOOSTER_FINISH_SPELL_UPGRADE_INFO: Instantly finish any spell upgrade in Home Village.
TID_BOOSTER_FINISH_TROOP_UPGRADE_INFO: Instantly finish any troop upgrade. Works in both villages!
TID_BOOSTER_FREE_BUILDING_UPGRADE_INFO: Instantly upgrade any Building to the next level. Requires a free Builder. Works in both Villages!
TID_BOOSTER_FREE_HERO_UPGRADE_INFO: Instantly upgrade any Hero or Pet to the next level. Works in both Villages!
TID_BOOSTER_FREE_SPELL_UPGRADE_INFO: Instantly upgrade any Spell to the next level in Home Village.
TID_BOOSTER_FREE_TROOP_UPGRADE_INFO: Instantly upgrade any Troop to the next level. Works in both Villages!
TID_BOOSTER_HERO_POTION_INFO: Boost all Heroes and Pets to their maximum level allowed by your Town Hall for <time>. Works in both Villages!
TID_BOOSTER_LAB_POTION_INFO: Boost Laboratory research to <multiplier>x its regular speed in Home Village for <time>. The Lab Assistant will not be affected.
TID_BOOSTER_MAX_LEVEL_ARMY_INFO: Boost Troops, Spells, and Siege Machines to their maximum level allowed by your Town Hall for 1h. Works in both Villages!
TID_BOOSTER_PET_POTION_INFO: Boost Pet upgrades to <multiplier>x their regular speed for <time>.
TID_BOOSTER_SHOVEL_OBSTACLE_INFO: Strong but fragile, this magical shovel can be used to make a single obstacle permanently movable. Works in both villages!
TID_BOOSTER_STAR_POTION_INFO: Instantly make your Star Bonus available in Builder Base.
TID_BOOSTER_SUPER_POTION_INFO: Can Boost a Troop into its Super Troop form for 3 days!
TID_BOOSTER_WALL_UPGRADE_INFO: Instantly upgrade a wall piece. Some higher level walls may require multiple rings to upgrade. Works in both villages!
TID_BOW_INFO: The X-Bow shoots mystical bolts with terrifying power. Load it with Elixir and the X-Bow works automagically. You can set it to target ground units at long ranges, or all targets at reduced range.
TID_BUILDER_APPRENTICE_INFO: Builder's Apprentice helps Builders complete upgrades faster. Assign him once a day and level him up to work even faster!
TID_BUILDING_ARCHER_CANNON_INFO: The Multi-Gear Tower is a powerful combination of two classic defenses! Choose the attack mode that suits you and let the destruction begin! Targets air and ground units.
TID_BUILDING_BOMB_TOWER_INFO: Bomb Towers bombard nearby ground troops and go up in a big BOOM when destroyed! Melee units best stand clear!
TID_BUILDING_CAKE_THROWER_INFO: One splash-damage serving at a time!\n\n Cake surrounding enemies in destructive and delectable... cake. When this dessert drops, it leaves an explosive surprise, ensuring no one is around for seconds.
TID_BUILDING_CRUSHER_INFO: The Crusher REALLY likes its personal space. This hulking stone slams ground units with a mighty wallop!
TID_BUILDING_DEBRIS_TOWER_INFO: If you destroy its building friends, the Revenge Tower will look for you, it will find you, and it will smite you. As fellow buildings fall, it grows stronger and angrier!
TID_BUILDING_GATLING_GUN_INFO: The Firespitter spews flames at a fire rate faster than the X-Bow! If it misses, the Firespitter will shoot past its target to deal damage to enemies behind. It can only face a single direction, so place carefully!
TID_BUILDING_HEADHUNTER_TOWER_INFO: Headhunter wants to play a game!\n\nThis destructive deck dealer targets all troops but serves extra damage to Heroes! Card projectiles cause slowdown and result in poisoned paper cuts.
TID_BUILDING_INFERNO_CANDLE_INFO: The flickering flame of the Hot Candle flings fire spurts at multiple surrounding enemies! Better make your wish quick, as this defense’s target capacity decreases as it melts.
TID_BUILDING_MONOLITH_INFO: Builder's first Dark Elixir experiment resulted in a truly frightful defense. The stronger the Monolith's target, the more damage it does. Great to have defending your village, but a little intimidating to take on.
TID_BUILDING_OTTOS_OUTPOST_INFO: O.T.T.O´s home and the main building of the second stage. May contain additional feisty robots.\n\nDestroying O.T.T.O´s Outpost awards an extra star in attacks.
TID_BUILDING_SCATTERSHOT_INFO: The Scattershot heaves very heavy objects at whoever happens to be closest. The projectile breaks apart on impact and deals additional damage to troops behind.
TID_BUILDING_SEASONAL_PLATFORM_INFO: Build Crafted Defenses and upgrade their stats however you like! Crafted Defenses last until a Crafting Phase ends. New defenses will take their place with the next phase! Experiment with new defenses and you might just find a new favorite!
TID_BUILDING_SPELL_TOWER_INFO: For years, Wizards alone brought magic to the battlefield one fireball at a time. Now they've developed a fully automated way to give your village more ways to mess up attackers with magic!
TID_BUILDING_VILLAGER_APPRENTICE_INFO: Helpers rest up on a warm bunk bed in this cozy little hut! Visit the Helper Hut and assign Helpers to jobs around the village.
TID_BUILDING_XBOW2_INFO: The X-Bow shoots powerful bolts with terrifying power. You can set it to target ground units or air units.
TID_CANNON2_INFO: The iconic ground defense, built to last! This classic makes the Master Builder a bit sentimental.
TID_CHARACTER_APPRENTICE_WARDEN_INFO: Despite his grand ambitions, Apprentice Warden is still just a student. Supports troops with his magical Life Aura and less-magical slingshot.
TID_CHARACTER_ELECTRO_TITAN_INFO: Barely controlling her raw magical power, Electro Titan is a formidable force on the battlefield. She channels some of her magic into a powerful electro whip while the rest spills out to damage everything around her.
TID_CHARACTER_ELEPHANT_RIDER_INFO: He crushed the Supercell Make competition, now he’s crushing villages!\n\n Walls that stand between Elephant Rider and the nearest defense get thrashed! The shock of defeat separates Elephant from his Rider — the little guy targets everything with a swirling mace, while the big guy continues to smash walls as he rushes more defenses!
TID_CHARACTER_INFERNO_DRAGON_INFO: Not getting upset over being alone anymore, the Inferno Dragon has learned to focus its rage into a very powerful beam that builds up over time!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_AD_SEEKER_WITH_EXPLOS: These fiery beasts can't resist chasing after Air Defenses, providing excellent protection for other troops. Once destroyed, they erupt into many smaller, weaker menaces.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_APRIL25BLTM: She is THE MAN! The Disarmer targets Defenses with spiteful blows of her bat and makes easy work of Walls by jumping right over them! She must be put down 3 times before she’s out. Talk about tough!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_APRIL25GTG: With the might of 10 Giants, the Giant Giant clobbers Defenses with massive splash damage. Uh-oh! If he loses half of his max health, he’ll rage out with increased speed and power.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_APRIL25RRBL: With huge range, YEETer hurls 4 loyal tribe members at the start of battle that attack everything, before going back to his trusty spears. Say it loud now, YEET!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_APRIL25TBRM: This tough Troop does what he wants! K.A.N.E. sees red, and goes straight for the Town Hall! He pummels ground and air units that get in his way with splash-damaging slams. When defeated, he is reborn in flames with increased damage and a fierce fiery aura.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_ARCHER: These sharpshooters like to keep their distance on the battlefield and in life. Nothing makes them happier than single-mindedly taking down their target.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_BABY_DRAGON2: Cute, snuggly, and prone to fire-spitting tantrums. Rampant destruction has never been so adorable.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_BALLOON: These promoted Skeletons have traded in their joy of destroying walls for a joy of destroying defenses. Deploy them to take out pesky Mortars and Cannons!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_BARBARIAN: This fearless warrior relies on his bulging muscles and striking mustache to wreak havoc in enemy villages. Release a horde of Barbarians and enjoy the mayhem!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_BARCHER: Combining the fierce toughness of a Barbarian with the tough fierceness of an Archer, the Barcher is a surprisingly effective attacker given its unhealthy appearance.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_BATTLERAM: Four Barbarians holding a big log race ahead to batter down their target, dealing big bonus damage if they connect; then they fight on with their swords!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_BOMBER: With an appetite for destruction and high quality special effects, Bombers blow up anything in sight with bonus damage to walls!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_BOWLER: This big blue dude digs the simple things in life - Dark Elixir drinks and throwing rocks. His massive boulders bounce off of their target and hit again behind it for a double strike!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_COOKIE_PEKKA: C.O.O.K.I.E doesn't just sweeten the battlefield with fierce fighting, this baked battler goes in armed with a pirouetting pretzel attack, dealing splash damage. It may leave devastation in its wake, but that's the way the cookie crumbles.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_COURIER: A trainee Witch who flies around the battlefield delivering Witch Spirits. She particularly dislikes snooty Wizards atop fancy towers.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_DARK_WITCH: Fearlessly summons flocks of flying creatures and, unlike her sister, leaves the grass in pristine condition.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_DRAGON: The might of the dragons is known throughout the land. This scaly terror of the skies feels no mercy and nothing will escape the fiery splashes of his breath.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_ELITE_BARBARIAN: Superior in health, power, speed and most importantly, hair, the Super Barbarians are what regular Barbarians dream of becoming!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_ELITE_GIANT: Super Giants are bigger than their ordinary cousins and are great at punching their way through walls. The belt is from the annual Village eating contest.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_ELITE_GOBLIN: Sneaky Goblins have a talent going unnoticed for a while after being deployed. It's usually the incredibly loud sound of resources being pilfered that gives them away.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_ELITE_WALLBREAKER: Who knew that rolling was that much superior to running? Super Wall Breakers use pre-ignited bombs that blow up under all circumstances! No more duds!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_FIRECRACKER: This pink-haired pyromaniac traded her Archer's bow for something with more firepower. Firecracker is always looking to fling her flamboyant fulminations at the nearest target; however, the recoil from her attacks sends her slightly backwards. She may be responsible for colorful and explosive displays during Lunar New Year, just don't leave anything flammable in her proximity.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_FREE_KICKER: Starts the match with a calm, carefully aimed shot that smashes the nearest Defense. Then goes on the usual Barbarian rampage.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_FURNACE: Furnace doesn’t move, but it does spawn Firemites over time that target buildings. These curious little guys leave pools of fire where they visit!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_GHOST: Upset that no one notices him, the Royal Ghost is determined to smash things up until he gets the recognition he deserves. He's so unnoticeable that even Walls won't hold him back!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_GIANT: These big guys may seem calm, but show them a Cannon or Archer Tower and you´ll see their fury unleashed! Slow yet durable, these warriors are best used to soak up hits.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_GIANT_SKELETON: Big boned from early age, the Giant Skeleton was always destined to blow up more than just Walls. His massive bomb damages everything around him after he is destroyed.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_GOBLIN: These pesky little creatures only have eyes for one thing: LOOT! They are faster than a Spring Trap, and their hunger for resources is limitless.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_GOLEM: The mighty Golem loves to soak up damage! When destroyed, it explodes and splits into Golemites. The resulting Golemites have one-fifth the Golem's strength and hitpoints.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_GRAVE_GOLEM: With the rock-hard determination of a Golem and the dark magics of a Witch, this monstrous mashup makes short work of enemy defenses!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_HASTY_BALLOON: Retrofitted with two carefully safety-inspected booster rockets, the Rocket Balloon gets a flying start to every battle!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_HEADHUNTER: Headhunter has just one job: taking out enemy Heroes. At her other job, she works at the Village Apothecary. She's lightweight enough to jump over walls, and her poisoned weapons make her targets move and attack slower.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_HEALER: This majestic creature lives to protect and aid her fellow troops. Any army is improved with her healing support, but make sure to protect her from air defenses!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_HOG_GLIDER: The real riders in the sky. They have a great track record in getting over walls, but are not very good at avoiding crashes.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_HOG_WIZARD: This dangerous duo merges the fiery attitude and magic of a Wizard with the relentless mobility of a Hog Rider. Opponents will shake in their boots at the sound of this pair approaching!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_ICEGOLEM: Ice Golem has a chilling personality and absolutely zero sense of humour. He frosts over everything he touches, freezes his surroundings when destroyed, and ices up when talked to at a party. On defense, his freeze effect is smaller and has a shorter duration.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_ICEMINION: Mixing the ferociousness of a Minion with the freeziness of an Ice Golem, the Ice Minion targets and slows down Defenses. Like a snowflake, it's fragile!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_IRONFIST_GIANT: Heavy-handed and built like an ox, these Giants have been practicing their haymaker punch!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_LAVALOON: Blending the powerfully blasty bombs of a Balloon with the rock-hard armour of a Lava Hound, the Lavaloon brings a base to ruin one boom at a time.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_LIGHTNINGDRAGON: Possessing iron-tough scales and a breath of devastating lightning, Electro Dragon's favorite thing is raining destruction from above. When vanquished, Electro Dragon even pummels the ground with lightning strikes!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_MAGIC_ARCHER: Having achieved serious arm strength, the Super Archer can now threaten targets several buildings away.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_MECHA: Is M.E.C.H.A a knight? A samurai? A robot? YES! M.E.C.H.A easily smashes through Walls in the way between her and the next Defense!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_MINION: This terror of the skies was born out of Dark Elixir. Undetectable by the Seeking Air Mine, Minions materialize with ease, but are fragile in our world.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_MOVING_CANNON: A Cannon on wheels?! Wait, did it just turn into a Mortar?? Bet they won´t see that coming! Both powerful and versatile!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_PARTY_WIZARD: The distant echo of a kick snare or high hat can only mean one thing; the Party Wizard is making his grand entrance. Dropping phat beats and massive fireballs, he's the soul of post-battle celebrations.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_PEKKA: Is P.E.K.K.A a knight? A samurai? A robot? No one knows! P.E.K.K.A´s armor absorbs even the mightiest of blows.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_PUMPKIN_BARBARIAN: Who would've thought that pumpkins make for good makeshift armor? The pumpkin helmets provide these regular Barbarians some extra hitpoints until they get destroyed.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_RAGED_BARBARIAN: Why is he so angry, speedy and vicious? Nobody's brave enough to ask. Maybe it's because he can't find his sword?
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_RAM_RIDER: She may not know the RAMifications of defeat as this Gingerbread Ram Rider is one tough cookie. This dessert duo is the best combination since Oreo and Juliet and makes Walls crumble like overbaked biscuits.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_RIDER: Having tamed the fierce leaping Hog, Hog Rider punishes those who hide behind their puny walls! Fueled by Dark Elixir, these warriors have never known defeat!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_SIDE_THROWER: This big budding sportsman throws a heavy bouncing ball at the nearest Building. Then he moves on to the typical Giant smashing!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_SIEGE_MACHINE_AIR_TRO: Tell walls to take a hike and drop troops from above. Sky Wagon delivery services are fast, reliable, and destructive!\n\nThough its wooden body can’t withstand a lot of damage, its mastery of the skies and immunity to spells more than make up for it.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_SIEGE_MACHINE_CARRIER: The Siege Barracks parachutes down gracefully to first release a menagerie of P.E.K.K.As and Wizards, and then the Clan Castle troops. How they all managed to squeeze inside is a mystery not really worth investigating.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_SIEGE_MACHINE_CATAPUL: This little charmer flings bundles of Fire Spirits that both hit hard and leave behind a burning mess. Its long range helps it stay out of trouble, but beware of longer range defenses and traps! Immune to spell effects.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_SIEGE_MACHINE_FLYER: The Battle Blimp bypasses ground-based obstacles and delivers your Clan Castle troops directly into the heart of the enemy village, all while dropping bombs along the way. However, its thin hide makes it easier to shoot down. Immune to spell effects.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_SIEGE_MACHINE_LOG_LAU: While Log Launcher certainly isn't the fastest or the sturdiest, it is definitely among the meanest. This trunk-throwing contraption pummels everything in front of it with endless logs to open up a path to the enemy Town Hall. Immune to spell effects.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_SIEGE_MACHINE_RAM: The Wall Wrecker exists for two simple purposes: to smash through anything that it comes across, and to deliver the Clan Castle Troops straight to the heart of the village. Built from heavy-duty materials, it can take a pummeling before breaking down. Immune to spell effects.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_SIEGE_MACHINE_TROOP_C: This immobile machine launches barrel loads of troops and Clan Castle Troops at your allies in battle to support them. Each barrel can hold multiple troops, including one Clan Castle Troop. There are only a few barrels inside, so make them count!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_SKELETON_BARREL: Is it a bird? Is it a plane? No, just Harry, Larry, Terry and a dozen friends, heading for the nearest building in a barrel of bones!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_SNAKE_BARREL: This Lunar New Year, it’s raining snakes! These green menaces are barrels of fun, and bite chunks out of Defenses. They’ll slither over Walls, and are effective in groups!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_SNEAKY_ARCHER: Cloaked under cover of moonlight, Archers can take out targets before ever being seen. Their weakness? Overconfidence.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_SUPER_CHARGED_PEKKA: Unstable energy radiates from this powerful suit of dark armor, waiting to be unleashed!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_SUPER_MINION: Super Minion's big forehead isn't just for show: sniping enemy defenses from a safe distance is simply a brainy move! Especially when you've grown too big to avoid Seeking Air Mines.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_SUPER_YETI: This mysterious masked Yeti is charged up! His electrical little buddies spring into action when he takes damage and zap the closest Building to spark a devastating chain reaction!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_TAX_COLLECTOR: Greedy fingers! The Debt Collector targets resource Buildings and loots way more than a regular Goblin. Additional Loot is not taken from the Defender. Instead, it is generated by the Debt Collector himself!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_THROWER: This powerful pitcher has his eye on the prize! The Thrower hurls mighty spears from long range at enemies and defenses. His secret? The strength lies in his fabulous facial hair!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_TOXIC_MINION: Attacks targets from a distance, glows in the dark, and is a maniac on the dance floor.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_TREANT: This earth warrior is so in tune with nature she doesn't need to walk herself. Riding into battle atop a tough tree root, Root Rider can smash through walls and slam defenses into dust.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_UNDEAD_WRESTLER: The troop for whom the bell tolls.\n\nYeti Undertaker buries his knuckles into defenses and deals extra damage to walls. He grows stronger throughout battle by absorbing the spirits of fallen allies. Defeating him is a grave mistake, as he will rise twice from beyond the tombstone, inviting his Skeletons of Darkness on each return to the mortal realm.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_VALKYRIE: A master of the two-handed axe, this glorious warrior runs between nearby buildings and can shred several troops or buildings at once with her whirlwind blow!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_WALLBREAKER: Nothing warms a Wall Breaker's cold and undead heart like blowing up walls. A squad of them will make way for your ground units, and they will do it with a BANG!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_WARLOCK: Witch never fights alone, constantly raising warriors from past battles to lead her attacks. Upgraded Witches raise more Skeletons at a time.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_WATER_DRAGON: The Year of the Azure Dragon represents strength and power, and this majestic wyrm embodies both. As a harbinger of spring and the coming rainfall, may Azure Dragon rain victory upon your battlefield. With its high hit points and piercing splash projectile that also deals damage behind its initial target, this mighty unit will definitely make sure your battles don't... drag on.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_WIZARD: The Wizard is a terrifying presence on the battlefield. Pair him up with some of his fellows and cast concentrated blasts of destruction on anything, land or sky!
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_WIZARD2: This Legendary wizard slows down enemy defenses with destructive shards of ice!\n\nOnly available for a limited time.
TID_CHARACTER_INFO_YETI: This heavy-hitting furry fellow digs cold weather and his Yetimite buddies. Hurt him, and you'll make the Yetimites real angry.
TID_CHARACTER_MECHA_DRAGON_INFO: This aerial engine of destruction readily and frankly, quite excitedly, lays waste to any defense it comes across. The Skeleton onboard swears he's not touching the controls.
TID_CHARACTER_RUIN_WITCH_INFO: After Ruin Witch lost her powers in an unusual alchemy accident, Master Builder crafted an ingenious invention to keep her summoning pursuits alive. \n\nThe Debrisbuster 5000 vacuums the remains of fallen buildings and spits out battle-ready Ruin Knights. The device self-destructs after deploying a certain number of units, taking Ruin Witch with it!
TID_CHARACTER_SHAPESHIFTER_DRUID_INFO: Druid has complicated emotions. One moment, he's calmly helping heal his fellow troops, and the next, he's turned into a very angry Bear.
TID_CHARACTER_SIEGE_BATTLE_DRILL_INFO: A fine example of Goblin ingenuity, the Battle Drill burrows underground towards the nearest defense. On arrival, it pops up to stun and demolish with its dastardly drill.
TID_CHARACTER_SUPER_HOG_RIDER_INFO: This dangerous duo of Hog and Rider are even more superb now. They ride together, they split up and keep fighting together.
TID_CHARACTER_SUPER_VALKYRIE_INFO: Not only are Super Valkyries superior to regular Valkyries in every way, they're also way more angry!
TID_CHARACTER_SUPER_WITCH_INFO: Focused magic creates focused results. Instead of summoning hordes of tiny skeletons, Super Witch summons just one really big skeleton with very formidable bone density.
TID_CHEST_COLLECTION_INFO: Trade 2 duplicates of the same card type to get a random Card.
TID_CHEST_COMMON_INFO: A Chest that contains a random reward!
TID_CHEST_EPIC_INFO: A Chest that contains at least an epic reward!
TID_CHEST_EVENT_INFO: A special Chest that contains random event rewards and Challenger Contracts!
TID_CHEST_RARE_INFO: A Chest that contains at least a rare reward!
TID_CLASHOWEEN_BUILDING_INFO: This haunted creation by the strangely behaving Builder transforms your regular Elixir Storages into Sour Elixir. Hopefully this is just temporary.
TID_CLOCK_TOWER_INFO: The Clock Tower makes things happen faster in your village! Collect resources, research and build faster.
TID_CONSUMABLE_BOOST_ARMY_INFO: A hearty meal that boosts Troops, Spells and Siege Machines to the maximum level for your Town Hall for the next <battles> battles. Works in the Home Village!
TID_CONSUMABLE_BOOST_BUILDER_INFO: A hearty bite that makes your Builders work <num>x as fast for <time>. Works in the Home Village! Sadly, the Builder’s Apprentice is a vegetarian and won't be boosted!
TID_CONSUMABLE_BOOST_HERO_INFO: A mighty meal that boosts Heroes, Pets and Equipment to the maximum level for your Town Hall for the next <battles> battles. Works in the Home Village!
TID_CONSUMABLE_BOOST_LAB_INFO: This bubbling broth makes your Laboratory research and Pet House upgrades <num>x as fast for <time>. Works in the Home Village!
TID_CONSUMABLE_CC_REFILL_INFO: A sweet deal! Add free Reinforcements to your Clan Castle for <time>. To enjoy this treat, join a Clan and add Reinforcements at your Clan Castle!
TID_CONSUMABLE_INSTANT_TRAINING_INFO: A quick bite that will instantly train all Troops, Spells and Siege Machines for <time> or at most <battles> battles.
TID_CREATE_SKELETONS_SPELL_INFO: Summon an army of Skeletons anywhere on the battlefield!\n\nPut a few extra swords when and where you need them most. Skeletons do not trigger traps.
TID_DARK_ELIXIR_BARRACK_INFO: The Dark Barracks will open doors for creatures born out of Dark Elixir. Upgrade the Barracks to unlock more Troops with unique battle skills.
TID_DARK_ELIXIR_PUMP_INFO: Our Builders have finally figured a way to extract pure Dark Elixir, the rarest form of the magical substance.
TID_DARK_ELIXIR_STORAGE_INFO: The power of Dark Elixir could not be contained in a regularly shaped Elixir vat. As it's three times as powerful, we had to invent a cubical form of storage!
TID_DARK_TOWER_INFO: Set the Inferno Tower's flame to inflict immense damage on single targets, or to constantly melt multiple targets at once.
TID_DOUBLE_CANNON_INFO: Double Cannons, double shots per Cannon, It's a double-double dose of trouble!
TID_DUPLICATE_SPELL_INFO: Turn this spell into a pop-up army!\n\nClone Spells create a circle of spawning that creates limited-lifetime copies of troops that enter it. It will only spawn up to a maximum housing space of troops.
TID_EARTHQUAKE_INFO: Weaken ground targets with crippling earthquakes!\n\nEarthquake Spells damage targets based on their maximum hitpoints. Repeated earthquakes deal decreasing damage to the same targets, but no wall can withstand the might of four Earthquake Spells!
TID_ELECTROFIRE_WIZARD_INFO: Master of Magic, Sorceror of Style, the Electrofire Wizard incinerates single targets or zaps multiple foes with charged electricity.
TID_ELIXIR_PUMP_INFO: Elixir is pumped from Ley Lines coursing underneath your village. Upgrade your Elixir Collectors to maximize Elixir production.
TID_ELIXIR_STORAGE_INFO: These storages contain the Elixir pumped from underground. Upgrade them to increase the maximum amount of Elixir you can store.
TID_FLAMER_INFO: Bathe foes with a fiery flood of scalding plasma! Both air and ground troops will feel the burn!
TID_FREEZE_SPELL_INFO: When the going gets hot, stay frosty!\n\nThe Freeze Spell sends out a cryogenic blast that temporarily immobilizes enemy troops and disables defensive buildings within its radius.
TID_GEAR_INFO_ACTION_FIGURE: Summons Giant Giant to fight by the Archer Queen’s side
TID_GEAR_INFO_ANGRY_TOME: Nearby friendly units do extra damage
TID_GEAR_INFO_ARCHER_CROWN: Summons a gang of invisible Archers
TID_GEAR_INFO_BARBARIAN_CROWN: Summons a pack of raged Barbarians
TID_GEAR_INFO_CLONING_CLOAK: Summons clones of the Archer Queen
TID_GEAR_INFO_DARK_CROWN: Boosts health and damage a total of 3 times when allies are defeated
TID_GEAR_INFO_DARK_ORB: Damages and slows down everything it touches
TID_GEAR_INFO_DEADLY_DASH: Dashes across the center of the village breathing fire and avoiding attacks
TID_GEAR_INFO_DRAGON_SCALE: Defenders who strike Dragon Duke are dealt a painful hand
TID_GEAR_INFO_EARTHQUAKE_BOOTS: Causes a powerful earthquake that destroys walls and damages ground targets
TID_GEAR_INFO_ELECTRO_ATTACK: Chomps a chain reaction through buildings surrounding Dragon Duke’s target, the electrickery damage decreases by <num>% with each chain
TID_GEAR_INFO_ELECTRO_SHIELD: Periodically damages everything around the Royal Champion
TID_GEAR_INFO_ETERNAL_TOME: Grand Warden and all nearby friendly units become immune to damage
TID_GEAR_INFO_FIRE_HEART: Slowly regenerates health and bursts into damaging flames when Dragon Duke falls
TID_GEAR_INFO_FIRE_IN_A_CAN: Throws a giant exploding fireball at the closest defense
TID_GEAR_INFO_FLAME_BREATH: Blows scorching fire that damages enemies and buildings
TID_GEAR_INFO_FOOTBALL: Shoots a Spiky Ball which smashes between buildings
TID_GEAR_INFO_FROST_CHARM: Flings flakes at the closest Defenses to freeze them
TID_GEAR_INFO_FROZEN_ARROW: Icy arrows slow down the targets they hit
TID_GEAR_INFO_GIANT_GAUNTLET: Barbarian King becomes gigantic, doing area damage and taking less damage
TID_GEAR_INFO_HEALING_TOME: Heals Grand Warden and all nearby friendly units
TID_GEAR_INFO_HEROIC_TORCH: Gives nearby Troops a burning desire to walk through Walls, move faster, and take less damage
TID_GEAR_INFO_HOG_TOTEM: Summons a stampede of Hog Riders
TID_GEAR_INFO_LIFE_GEM: Nearby friendly units gain extra hitpoints
TID_GEAR_INFO_METEOR_WAND: Summons mysterious meteors that repeatedly strike the nearest Defense
TID_GEAR_INFO_MINION_BODYGUARDS: Summons flying bodyguards to support Minion Prince
TID_GEAR_INFO_MONOLITH_ARROW: Monolith Arrow's extra damage decreases when more than <num> and <num2> housing spaces of units are deployed
TID_GEAR_INFO_PIERCING_ARROW: Shoots a giant piercing arrow that crosses the entire village
TID_GEAR_INFO_ROCKET_SPEAR: Her next few spear throws are stronger and longer-ranged
TID_GEAR_INFO_ROYAL_CLOAK: Turns the Queen invisible and gives her stronger attacks
TID_GEAR_INFO_SEEKING_SHIELD: Throws her shield which bounces between defenses and deals damage
TID_GEAR_INFO_SNAKE_ARMOR: Summon snakes that fight by your side when taking damage
TID_GEAR_INFO_STICK_HORSE: Gallop over walls and get increased movement and attack speed after being deployed
TID_GEAR_INFO_STONE_AMULET: Creates a protective barrier that reduces damage taken temporarily
TID_GEAR_INFO_STUN_BLAST: Blasts a shockwave that stuns and damages nearby enemies and buildings.
TID_GEAR_INFO_TURBO_START: Increases the speed, range, and power of Minion Prince’s first few attacks
TID_GEAR_INFO_VAMPSTACHE: Barbarian King heals himself every time that he attacks
TID_GEM_MINE_INFO: Gem Mines access a rare deposit of this highly valuable resource! Mining Gems is slow and hard work.
TID_GIANT_CANNON_INFO: Nothing gets in the way of the Giant Cannon. Its mammoth-sized cannon balls push past anything and just keep going and going and going...
TID_GOLD_MINE_INFO: The Gold Mine produces Gold. Upgrade it to boost its production and Gold Storage capacity.
TID_GOLD_STORAGE_INFO: All your precious Gold is stored here. Don't let sneaky Goblins anywhere near! Upgrade the storage to increase its capacity and durability against attacks.
TID_GUARD_POST_INFO: Houses troops to aid in defense! These rabble rousers are sure to slow down the enemy.
TID_HASTE_INFO: Enrage your units to make them bigger, faster and stronger!\n\nCast this to create a Ring of Rage! Your units will gain speed and attack power while they are inside this ring.
TID_HEALING_WAVE_INFO: Heal your troops to keep them in the fight!\n\nCast this spell to create a Ring of Healing. Your units will be healed while they are inside this ring.
TID_HERO_INFO_BATTLE_COPTER: Get to the Copter! Tired of hammering through walls, Master Builder's next-generation flying machine lets him soar over them. The Battle Copter attacks from afar with its powerful Cannons; or can get up close and personal when using its Bomb Rush ability.
TID_HERO_INFO_DRAGON_DUKE: Locked away for his anger issues, this tanky flying Hero gets madder and mightier when separated from friendly flying units. His royal rampage boosts damage by 100%, attack speed by 50%, and reduces damage taken from traps. When defending, he can only be attacked by air-targeting enemies.
TID_HERO_INSTRUCTIONS_BARBARIAN: Biggest and bravest of all Barbarians, this colossal menace soaks up huge amounts of damage and smashes anything in his path with his sword. He guards his territory fiercely when defending.
TID_HERO_INSTRUCTIONS_MINION_HERO: This self-proclaimed Prince of Darkness means business! Minion Prince takes to the skies and dishes damage to targets with dark magic! When defending, he can only be attacked by air-targeting enemies.
TID_HERO_INSTRUCTIONS_QUEEN: Towering above all other Archers, this graceful huntress is a master of destructive force. Although her health is modest, she snipes targets from afar with her powerful X-Bow. As a defender, she guards the village with a vengeance.
TID_HERO_INSTRUCTIONS_ROYAL_CHAMPION: Over the wall and at them! Royal Champion is only afraid of four things, and the enemy isn't one of them. Her short range is perfect for stabbing defenses up close and personal.
TID_HERO_INSTRUCTIONS_WARDEN: This powerful master of magic supports troops by blasting enemies with his staff! Grand Warden can even walk or fly over walls! He’ll make a majestic stand at his Hero Banner when defending.
TID_HERO_INSTRUCTIONS_WARMACHINE: The Master Builder's prize invention smashes enemy buildings to bits. What better way is there to show who's the best builder around? Unlock the Electric Hammer ability to give opponents a real pounding!
TID_HERO_TAVERN_INFO: This fancy Hall honors your Village's mightiest warriors! Visit the Hero Hall for all your heroic essentials, and to upgrade Heroes. Upgrade the Hero Hall to unlock more Heroes!
TID_HOUSING2_INFO: Your troops are stationed in Army Camps. Each camp can house only one troop type at a time. Some troops can be upgraded to fit more units per camp!
TID_HOUSING_INFO: Your troops are stationed in Army Camps. Build more camps and upgrade them to muster a powerful army.
TID_ICE_BLOCK_SPELL_INFO: A brrr-illiant defensive strategy!\n\nCast this cool concoction to encase your ground and air troops in ice that blocks almost all damage but freezes their movement and attack!
TID_ICE_HOUND_INFO: Free from all that lava-induced indigestion, the Ice Hound is ready to freeze the flow of battle. Chill out, or else.
TID_INFERNO_GUARDIAN_INFO: Use your head! Longshot fires explosive bolts from her cranium at long range, peppering attackers with delightful dollops of splash damage.
TID_INFO_BALLOON_CARRIER: Packed to the brim with bones instead of bombs, Skeletons leap out of these balloons directly next to the enemy!
TID_INVISIBILITY_SPELL_INFO: Invisibility Spell makes EVERYTHING, except for walls and Siege Machines, invisible and untargetable within its radius.
TID_JUMP_SPELL_INFO: Walls slowing you down? Try making a shortcut!\n\nCast this spell near enemy walls to create a route straight over them. Your troops will jump over affected wall pieces as if they weren't even there!
TID_LABORATORY_INFO: What dark secrets do these Wizards hide inside their Laboratory? Nobody has dared to look. All we know is that their research makes our spells and troops harder, better, faster, and stronger!
TID_LAVA_LAUNCHER_INFO: Hurls molten rock over great distances. Sets the ground on fire, which really turns up the heat for enemy ground troops!
TID_LIGHTNING_STORM_INFO: Electrocute your enemies with a bolt of lightning!\n\nCast this spell at the enemy village to damage and stun buildings and units inside a small area.
TID_LOGGER_GUARDIAN_INFO: A hardened meteorite hunk with a fascination for forestry. When Logger isn’t petting his mustache woodpeckers, he’s lobbing bouncing logs that push and crush all troop types.\n\nThe timber may be slow, but it strikes with the full force of nature!
TID_MEGA_TESLA_INFO: What happens when a Tesla goes Mega? Its powerful jolt deals heavy damage to even the toughest units!
TID_MELEE_AREA_GUARDIAN_INFO: This tanky Guardian deals splash damage to ground and air troops. Smasher is a seriously sore loser, raging when the Town Hall is destroyed and leaving rage in his wake when defeated.
TID_MERGED_WIZARD_TOWER_INFO: Super Wizard’s first strike can shock up to fifteen nearby enemies. Chained targets take less damage.
TID_METEOR_GOLEM_INFO: From the cosmos, to your army! This lob-loving duo will throw themselves at anything for up-close damage. When separated, Meteormites will attack nearby targets or find a friend to form a Meteor Golem!
TID_MINER_INFO: These sneaky shovelers burrow underground, pass beneath walls, and pop up right next to their targets. While underground, Miners cannot be damaged and will not trigger traps, but still gain bonuses from spells.
TID_MINI_SPELL_FACTORY_INFO: Only the most brilliant or reckless Master Wizards dabble in Dark Elixir brewery. Their compact Dark Spells require keen insight to master, but provide unique tactical advantages.
TID_MORTAR_INFO: The Mortar can mow down hordes of attackers with splash damage. Just don't let enemies get too close!
TID_MULTI_ARCHER_TOWER_INFO: These Archers have teamed up to take out attackers faster and more furiously than ever. Teamwork makes the dream work!
TID_MULTI_MORTAR_INFO: Fires long range splash damage multiple times to maximize chances of hitting its target!
TID_PET_ANGRY_JELLY_INFO: This blob of pure anger gets impatient waiting around the village, it's hungry for a good fight. During battle, it convinces its Hero to attack defenses before splitting to fight separately.
TID_PET_DIGGY_INFO: Diggy is an introvert and spends a lot of time hiding underground. Still, when it comes to battle, he'll do his part, coming up to attack buildings and aid his Hero. If his Hero's taken out, he'll seek out a new one for support and scritches.
TID_PET_FROSTY_INFO: Frosty is the coolest Pet... literally. Not only does his icy breath cause enemies to chill out, but he also releases swarms of Frostmites to further slow down defenses and help his Hero.
TID_PET_HEALER_INFO: Unicorns have severe trust issues, but overcoming them with love and patience is totally worth it. They'll heal up any minor or major scrapes as well as any Healer!
TID_PET_MELEEJUMPER_INFO: The trustiest hound to ever roam the village proper, L.A.S.S.I chases enemies with unrelenting fury. Unless they fly, in which case she just observes them intently.
TID_PET_PHOENIX_INFO: A true friend will egg you on when things get rough. Phoenix starts the battle as a helpless egg, but at the moment her Hero might go down, she hatches. The furious fiery fowl then gives temporary invulnerability to its Hero and engages nearby enemies.
TID_PET_POISON_LIZARD_INFO: Always the fastest never the lastest, Poison Lizard spits slowing toxins at its foes. Is it actually a venom lizard? Possibly, but who's brave enough to correct it?
TID_PET_RANGEDATTACKER_INFO: Electro Owl zaps enemy defenses into dust from great distance. He's mostly made of feathers though, so better keep him well protected!
TID_PET_RAVEN_INFO: No scarecrow is frightening enough to keep Greedy Raven away from shiny loot! This masked bandit’s swift feathers target and deal extra damage to resource buildings and egos.
TID_PET_SHOP_INFO: Every Hero deserves a loyal companion. The Pet House allows you to unlock powerful Pets with various abilities to fight alongside your Heroes.
TID_PET_SNEEZY_INFO: Her nose is blocked and loaded! Sneezy hangs behind her Hero due to allergies and sneezes tanky air Boogers that target buildings. She goes on the attack when her Hero falls!
TID_PET_SPIRIT_FOX_INFO: An extremely shy creature who's happiest alone in the woods outside the village. When called to battle, Spirit Fox fights fiercely alongside their Hero and helps them with a little invisibility.
TID_PET_WALLBUSTER_INFO: Built like a Siege Machine, the Mighty Yak has a knack for knocking down any walls it comes in contact with. It also flies into a rage if you knock out its companion.
TID_POISON_CLOUD_INFO: Give your army the upper hand against enemy troops with this deadly poison!\n\nDefending units that linger in a Poison Spell's toxic cloud will move slower, attack slower and take damage with increasing severity over time. Poison Spells do not affect structures.
TID_PUSHER_INFO: Toss ground troops in a direction you choose. Heave ho!
TID_RECOVERY_BUILDING_INFO: Brews up a hearty and nourishing cauldron of soup following Master Builder's grandma's recipe. Troops eat some on their way to the next stage of an attack, recovering some of their health.
TID_REINFORCEMENT_CAMP_INFO: Reinforcement Camps provide helpful reinforcements during battles when reaching the corresponding stage.
TID_RESEARCHER_APPRENTICE_INFO: Lab Assistant helps speed up research. Assign him once a day and level him up to work even faster!
TID_RICOCHET_CANNON_INFO: Builder has used one weird trick to develop a devastating cannonball that will ricochet and hit a second target.
TID_SIEGE_MACHINE_BALLOON_INFO: The Stone Slammer is a heavy-duty, flying mountain that targets defensive buildings by flattening them with giant boulders and causes earthquakes. Immune to spell effects.
TID_SIEGE_WORKSHOP_INFO: The Workshop is where Siege Machines are built. Upgrade the Workshop to unlock different Siege Machines!
TID_SMITHY_INFO: Bring the right magical Ores here and your Heroes' Equipment can be upgraded to be even mightier! The smoke from the furnace helps make delicious, if unhealthy, brisket.
TID_SPEEDUP_INFO: Put some hustle in even your heaviest units!\n\nHaste Spells lack the damage boost of Rage Spells, but provide an even better boost to movement speed. A lower storage space also allows you to take more of them into battle!
TID_SPELL_BAG_OF_FROSTMITES_INFO: Briefly freezes the target area and slowly summons bouncing Frostmites which slow down and distract the nearby defenses.
TID_SPELL_BATS_INFO: Summon an army of Bats anywhere on the battlefield!\n\nDeploy aerial reinforcements wherever you need them the most. Bats do not trigger traps.
TID_SPELL_FORGE_INFO: The Spell Factory is home to veteran Wizards who are better suited to creating magical weapons than front-line combat. Use their powerful Attack Spells to turn the tide of battle in your favor!
TID_SPELL_OVERGROWTH_INFO: Ever wish you could ignore a whole chunk of the enemy’s base? The Overgrowth Spell traps nearby buildings in tough roots, preventing defenses from attacking. Troops ignore trapped buildings.
TID_SPELL_RECALL_INFO: Attack going badly? Need to come in from another direction? The Recall Spell summons back troops, Heroes and Pets to the deployment bar. You can then send the recalled units back out for a second strike.
TID_SPELL_REVIVE_INFO: The Healer's own special recipe! The Revive Spell brings a defeated Hero in its range back into the fight with some health. Bring this spell into battle, and a floating golden heart will appear above any defeated Hero that can be revived. Upgrade the Revive Spell to increase the amount of health Heroes regain.
TID_SPELL_YELLOW_CARD_INFO: Bad sportsmanship deserves punishment and spoiling your attack is rude. Temporarily suspend the targeted Defense or Hero. They can't attack or be attacked while suspended.
TID_SUPER_BOWLER_INFO: Super Bowler now has everything he's ever wanted: a grippier glove, more comfortable footwear, and even more ridiculously massive boulders to toss.
TID_SUPER_DRAGON_INFO: Sometimes having a fire inside of you isn't enough. The Super Dragon has fires on the inside, outside, and if he gets to do his thing, all around him!
TID_SUPER_MINER_INFO: Armed with a powerful drill and a magnificent moustache, Super Miner is ready to undermine any rival Village!
TID_SUPER_WIZARD_INFO: Super Wizard is positively charged with magical energy! He's either the smartest person in the room... or else he blows the whole room to bits.
TID_TELESCOPE_INFO: The Star Laboratory searches the heavens for secrets to unlock a troop's full potential. Improve troop hitpoints, damage and housing space in addition to special troop abilities!
TID_TESLA_TOWER2_INFO: Part tower, part trap, completely shocking! Zap air and ground foes alike with the power of science!
TID_TESLA_TOWER_INFO: Lay a deadly trap with the Hidden Tesla! Our Wizards have trapped a storm cloud into each of these sneaky towers. When an enemy walks or flies close enough, the tower springs up and fries it using the power of Electrickery!
TID_TOTEM_SPELL_INFO: Incoming! Ground and air defenses in a Totem’s landing zone are damaged and stunned. Stunned defenses will redirect their focus to the closest available unit. Forged from dense cosmic rock, Totems can soak up a lot of damage.
TID_TOWN_HALL2_INFO:
Home of the Master Builder and the main objective in battle.

Destroying a Builder Hall awards a Star in attacks. Destroying 50% of buildings in a stage gains you a second Star, while 100% destruction awards three Stars for the stage.

Upgrade the Builder Hall to unlock advanced buildings and troops!
TID_TOWN_HALL_INFO: The heart of your village! Upgrade your Town Hall to unlock new defenses, buildings, traps, and much more.\n\nDestroying an opponent's Town Hall earns you one star in battle. Protect your Town Hall from attacks by placing it in the middle of your village and surrounding it with walls, traps, and defenses.
TID_TRAP_AIR_INFO: Latest invention in the field of flying pest control. This trap can blast multiple air units in a small area.
TID_TRAP_AIR_MEGA_INFO: Is it a bird? Is it a plane? Well it makes no difference as the Seeking Air Mine will blow it sky high. This trap does devastating damage to a single air unit.
TID_TRAP_EJECTOR_BB_INFO: This bouncy little number launches a small troop out of battle! Big troops with higher Housing Space are pushed back and damaged.
TID_TRAP_EJECTOR_INFO: This bouncy little number tosses an unwanted visitor right off your property!
TID_TRAP_GIGA_BOMB_INFO: Villagers didn't want to keep this dangerous weapon inside the Town Hall, so they moved it out! The Giga Bomb pushes enemies back with massive damage. This trap is so deadly, it doesn't need to hide!
TID_TRAP_HALLOWEEN_SKEL_INFO: Ambush and distract unsuspecting foes with a surprise skirmish of short-lived, but sneaky skeleton troops! Skeleton Traps can be configured to pursue either ground or air troops.
TID_TRAP_MINE_INFO: Nothing says 'STAY OUT' quite like a good old-fashioned hidden bomb.
TID_TRAP_SUPERBOMB_INFO: When you're looking for a Big Boom, you need the Giant Bomb.
TID_TRAP_TORNADO_INFO: Wind and stones may break some bones, but this trap will definitely confound you. Just place one of these traps down, and the released vortex will draw the enemy troops in, hindering their charge.
TID_WALL_INFO: Walls are great for keeping your village safe and your enemies in the line of fire.
TID_WARMACHINE_INFO: This massive machine broke attempting to hoist the realm's biggest hammer. With some repairs, it could be taken into battle!
TID_WEAPON_TOWN_HALL_17_INFO: Bring the heat! The Inferno Artillery launches 4 enemy-seeking explosives and leaves burning pools of fire where it strikes. If there are less than 4 enemies in range, it can strike the same target multiple times. Ouch!
TID_WIZARD_TOWER_INFO: The Ultimate Arcane Defense! Tower Wizards cast powerful area effect spells that target both flying and ground troops.
TID_WORKER2_INFO: Master Builder saved this little guy from the scrap heap. Despite a few loose screws, B.O.T.O is eager to help with tasks around Builder Base!
TID_WORKER_INFO: Nothing gets done around here without Builders! You can hire more builders to start multiple construction projects, or speed up their work by using green gems.
TID_XMAS_SPELL_INFO: Ask Santa for the best present there is: a hail of destruction raining down on your enemies!
